memory_candidates.content: Mathlib's dupNamespace env linter flags fully-qualified names with a consecutive repeated component (e.g. Cslib.Logic.Tableau.Tableau.foo); when a plan names lemmas 'Tableau.foo' inside namespace Cslib.Logic.Tableau, declare them directly in that namespace rather than opening a nested Tableau sub-namespace.

For CSLib counting lemmas over Finset chains, Finset.card_lt_card and Finset.card_le_card need no DecidableEq; including an unused [DecidableEq β] instance argument trips the unusedArguments env linter at lake lint.
